messages:
maria: FYI — ACME POC kickoff. Need to lock success criteria and blockers by Friday. 2-week POC: chat + embeddings for knowledge assistant. Key asks: latency p95 target, cost guidance, security checklist, and acceptance gates. Who can own prompts/evals and infra sizing?

alana: I can own prompts + evals. need sample prompts and an eval rubric from the PM or AE. also want the expected eval size (automated vs human). :white_check_mark:

maria: putting a quick draft here — feel free to iterate. basic eval plan: 200 prompt/ground-truth pairs, hold-out 50 for human review. acceptance if human accept rate >= 85% OR automated F1 >= 0.80 on intent/entity tasks. latency target request: p95 <= 250ms for single-turn chat. cost target: goal <$0.02 per 1k tokens processed (ballpark). Security: VPC peering, customer KMS, SOC2 report + DPA.

```
Sample prompts (short):
- "Find the latest invoice for Acct 412 and summarize charges."
- "Explain why a transaction with ID 0xA1 failed and next steps."
- "Given policy X, is this user action allowed? If not, show rule and mitigation."

Eval rubric (automated):
- Intent accuracy (macro-F1) with threshold 0.80
- Entity extraction (token F1) threshold 0.78

Human pass criteria: reviewer labels answer as "acceptable" for production use >= 85% of samples.
```

chris: infra notes — they want sustained throughput ~200 rps during peak. For latency we should consider dedicated instances (reserved capacity) and prefix cache. If we go hosted with burst it might not be reliable. estimating 3-4 GPUs (A100-level) for headroom. Also need to confirm model flavor + quantization (fp16 vs int8) — that changes cost/latency.

sam: for p95 <250ms we should enable KV/prefix caching and disable large batch windows for chat routes. I'll draft an autoscale profile: min 2 nodes, scale to 6, burst policy to 8 for short spikes. Need SSO + KMS details from customer to stand up private. Also putting eng-oncall on the runbook.

sec-bot: Security checklist link: https://internal.redwood/security/questionnaires/acme-poc. Required: DPA signed, SOC2 report, KMS integration, VPC peering, IP allowlist. Note: Legal requires DPA before any PII test data is uploaded.

alana: pricing — propose to offer 2-week POC credits (covering dev + 2 dedicated days) + discounted per-hour dedicated rate if they want reserved capacity. Quick estimate: projected infra burn ~$3k for the POC (depends on quantization), plus $500 for support/ops. I'll produce a short quote.

maria: acceptance gates (suggested):
- Latency: p95 <= 300ms across test harness (we can be stricter for internal ops, but give them a slightly wider gate)
- Quality: human accept rate >= 85% on holdout set OR automated metrics meet thresholds above
- Security: DPA + KMS + VPC set up, no critical findings in security review
- Operational: on-call runbook in place, incident escalation confirmed

chris: blocker — Legal needs DPA signed. If DPA not signed by Tue, risk missing setup window and we can't ingest any sample PII. Also need confirmation on model size (they prefer Llama-3-70B quantized) — that affects memory/latency.

sam: action items: I'll make a runbook template and include prometheus dashboards and trace hooks. alana — please send final prompt set. maria — chase DPA. I'll schedule infra pre-provisioning once model flavor is confirmed.

maria: thanks. Sync to finalize: Thu 11:00am PT in presales-room. +1 if that works. :calendar:

alana: +1

chris: +1

sam: +1

maria: I'll also attach customer-provided sample dataset after legal confirms DPA. If anyone has additional blockers, flag here so we can escalate.
